entry.title: GPP Link 1.0.0
entry.summary: GPP Link 1.0.0 — first release Send beats over Wi-Fi between your MPC (or Force), the Beats folder on your computer, and Get Producers Paid. What's in it - Cassette deck: preview any beat from your computer on the MPC, with turning reels and a scrolling waveform (you can resample it, too) - SEND TO MPC, SEND TO FOLDER, SEND TO GET PRODUCERS PAID and SEND STEMS TO GET PRODUCERS PAID - Phone page: browse your Beats folder, Cue or Send beats to any MPC - Beats always land on MPC User, even when the
